acceptance_rule.MODEL_UNDER_APPROXIMATES: model >= SUMO free run on every route
acceptance_rule.MODEL_STILL_OPTIMISTIC: the model is earlier than the free run on any route

criterion: SIGN, not accuracy: UNDER is a guarantee, not an estimate
controls: sigma=0 as well as SUMO's default, to separate model optimism from the default driver
model distance against SUMO odometer distance
